summary: The coordinator's correction to #81's premise is right in substance and inexact in its stated form, and both halves had to be re-measured: main does carry 13 merge commits, so 'every commit on main has exactly one parent' is false globally, but since the last of them (4fc6993) all 10 commits on main are single-parent, which is what actually makes a feature-branch sha uncitable.
evidence: command:git rev-list --merges --count origin/main prints 13; command:git rev-list --count 4fc6993..origin/main prints 10 and git rev-list --merges --count 4fc6993..origin/main prints 0; command:git merge-base --is-ancestor b689137 origin/main exits 1 while git cat-file -t b689137 prints commit; command:git rev-parse item-62-templatedrift-symlink-boundary-robustness:build.fsx and git rev-parse d2c4e2f:build.fsx both print 50e64333bb634ec38a0ddc98bd5fbff633f87ca0 while that branch tip is not an ancestor of main
